facts.fact: Annex 7 to the National Data Sharing Policy, issued by the Ministry of ICT and Innovation, says an accredited provider such as RISA will develop and implement a data sharing platform between government entities, possibly based on the Government Enterprise Services Bus or an API gateway.

facts.fact: Annex 7 says the Data Protection Office of the Rwanda National Cyber Security Agency fulfils the role of Data Protection Commissioner, the supervisory authority under Law N° 058/2021, and enforces its requirements.
